articles.title: India lines up military camels and eagles for annual parade (VIDEO)
articles.summary: As India celebrates Republic Day on January 26, the annual parade will feature a unique spectacle. The Indian Army’s animal contingent, part of the Remount and Veterinary Corps, is anticipated to be a major highlight, drawing significant attention. This special unit's participation underscores the vital role and unique capabilities of animals in military service during this national celebration.

articles.title: MACC targets more people of interest in military contracts probe
articles.summary: The Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission (MACC) has identified more individuals in an ongoing corruption probe concerning military contract tenders. This investigation highlights the critical need for transparency and integrity in defence procurement processes globally. Such probes underscore the importance of robust oversight mechanisms to prevent graft, ensuring national security assets are acquired ethically and efficiently, which is vital for any nation's defence preparedness.

articles.title: Maruti Suzuki records highest-ever production in CY25 at over 22.55 lakh units
articles.summary: Maruti Suzuki India Ltd (MSIL) reported record production of over 22.55 lakh units in calendar year 2025, its highest-ever annual output. This achievement marks the second consecutive year the company has reached such a significant milestone. The robust production figures highlight MSIL's strong manufacturing capabilities and continued dominance in the Indian automotive market, reflecting strong demand and operational efficiency within the sector.

articles.title: Serving constable, contract killer held in ex-IAF officer’s murder; sons accused of hiring hitmen
articles.summary: Police identified two contract killers, including a serving constable, in the murder of a retired Indian Air Force officer who was shot dead near his house. This incident raises concerns about the security of ex-servicemen and the integrity within law enforcement. Authorities are actively investigating the motive and full circumstances surrounding this targeted killing, emphasizing the need for robust internal security measures.

articles.title: Fiorentina reach agreement with Spurs over Israel forward Solomon
articles.summary: Italian club Fiorentina has reached an agreement with England's Tottenham Hotspur to sign Israeli winger Manor Solomon on a loan deal. This significant international football transfer is currently pending the player's medical examination. Solomon is expected to join the Serie A side, a move reported by The Athletic, impacting both clubs' squad dynamics for the upcoming season.
